tasks.requirement: Reject an empty iterable of secret keys when constructing a Signer, immediately with ValueError, rather than allowing later signing or key access to fail. Cover empty lists, tuples and one-shot iterators. Preserve accepted individual string and bytes keys, including empty string and empty bytes keys, and nonempty key collections. Preserve signing, verification, tamper rejection and oldest-to-newest key rotation. Make the smallest code change needed; do not change unrelated behavior.
